data.data_quality_notes: There is a significant discrepancy between the calculated gross prior year development (a strengthening of GBP 9.493m derived from the claims development triangle) and the narrative statements regarding net prior year development. One narrative states a net loss (strengthening) of GBP 2.0m for 2019 and 2017 & prior years of account, while another states a net release (surplus) of GBP 3.5m from reassessment of net claims incurred for previous accident years. The gross figure from the triangle is used as per instructions, with this note highlighting the conflicting information.
